notes: Math classroom Stage 2 (student profiles with a Recent-classes quick-fill, a second non-kiosk join entry path, teacher-controlled leave-lock, and performance auto-grouping), plus real bug fixes: multiple local math-student bots no longer all pile into the same class, ungrouping a plugin in the Plugin Canvas no longer silently disables it, presentation mode and F11 fullscreen no longer overlap the dashboard, and a genuine student-roster overflow bug is fixed. Also fixes the in-app updater itself: the sidecar process wasn't confirmed dead before the installer tried to overwrite it, which could leave a mismatched app/server version pair on a bad race -- verified end to end this time with a real click of the actual Update button, not just a fresh install.
